# `sarif-schema-2.1.0.json`

The SARIF 2.1.0 JSON Schema (OASIS Standard, errata 01), vendored so the
SARIF tests validate offline. Its `id` is the official location:
https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json

Copied unchanged from the OASIS SARIF Technical Committee's repository,
`oasis-tcs/sarif-spec` at commit `1742a253eb654bf8a4ed7c60eaef7412b2c23553`,
path `sarif-2.1/schema/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json`.

SHA-256: `c3b4bb2d6093897483348925aaa73af03b3e3f4bd4ca38cef26dcb4212a2682e`

Do not edit it. To update, replace it with a newer copy from the same source
and update the commit and checksum above.
